answer_4.quote: 33 annotators from 11 Arab countries (3 each) labeled each sentence for (a) validity in the annotator's country-level dialects and (b) Arabic Level of Dialectness (ALDi).
answer_4.guideline: For each sample in the dataset, the annotators (a) identified if a speaker of one of their country-level dialects could have authored the tweet. If an annotator answered (a) as yes, then the sentence is also (b) rated for its ALDi as MSA (L0), Colloquial-influenced MSA (L1), Normal Colloquial (L2), or Informal (or Vulgar) Colloquial (L3).
